title: Project Current State — Mature, Active, Unknown
authority: project-status projection; not a replacement for canonical owners or TODO.md
purpose: Give readers and maintainers a compact current-state view of what is structurally mature, what is under active development, and what remains unresolved or source-limited.

mature.title: Public architecture
mature.summary: Five canonical gateways, registered specialist surfaces, seven reader families, semantic parents and the House/Rooms distinction are explicitly governed and validator-backed.

mature.title: House ownership model
mature.summary: Ten Dwellings and 38 nested Rooms have ownership, holdings, dossiers, inhabitants/cases and guarded interfaces.

mature.title: Source and evidence boundaries
mature.summary: The archive distinguishes first-party material, external records, creative sources, comparison, reconstruction, model status and unresolved recovery rather than treating every source as equivalent.

mature.title: Timeline reader
mature.summary: Timeline now has a substantial static chronology plus dynamic exploration, hinge-period handling and explicit date/evidence boundaries.

mature.title: Politics reader
mature.summary: Politics has a canonical dated compendium, policy-domain projection, source-recovery queue, implementation tests and neutral current-context boundaries.

active.title: World relational cases
active.summary: Country examples exist, but cross-border energy, data/semiconductor and shipping/logistics cases still need fuller projection and refresh discipline.

active.title: Creative artifact recovery
active.summary: Works now distinguishes artifact states, but original images, audio, builds, prompts and version histories remain incomplete across several media.

active.title: Story scene sourcing
active.summary: Story has a static life spine; the next work is ordinary-life texture, scene-level provenance, streaming/internet history and unresolved dates.

active.title: Public-surface purpose audit
active.summary: Surface missions exist and a new substance heatmap is wired into Content quality; the first exact-head report still needs review and follow-up.

active.title: Built-site route review
active.summary: The architecture auditor can inspect built-page orphans, dead ends and short cycles once an exact-head _site build is available; real findings still need remediation.

unresolved.title: Missing original artifacts
unresolved.summary: Some remembered posts, chat excerpts, stream segments, prompts, songs, images and early project artifacts are known only through partial or later recovery.
unresolved.resolution: Recover original artifact or a sufficiently attributable contemporaneous copy.

unresolved.title: Exact dates and first attestations
unresolved.summary: Several biographical, role-development and source-history questions remain approximate, range-based or limited by the earliest currently recovered source.
unresolved.resolution: Recover dated primary material or an independent record that narrows the clock.

unresolved.title: Science-adjacent model interpretation
unresolved.summary: Some equations and formal comparators are exact mathematics while their physical or biological interpretation remains hypothetical or unvalidated.
unresolved.resolution: Specify observables, baseline models and discriminating tests.

unresolved.title: World data gaps
unresolved.summary: Many countries and institutions still have uneven source density, stale observations or incomplete ownership/dependency graphs.
unresolved.resolution: Add dated compatible public/primary sources and retain explicit unknown fields.

unresolved.title: Reception and downstream effects
unresolved.summary: For many works and public interventions, the archive knows that an object existed but does not yet have robust measurement of who encountered it or what changed downstream.
unresolved.resolution: Attach platform/source metrics or dated reception evidence without substituting anecdote for measurement.

rule: Mature means the architecture or reader has an explicit owner, meaningful population and validation path; it does not mean exhaustive or infallible. Active means the next improvement is known. Unknown means the missing evidence or discriminator is itself part of the record.
